verdict.rationale: Plaid documents that it verifies identification documents and markets authentication of 'global ID documents'. It also mentions country-based conditional checks, so document verification across countries is claimed. However, the evidence never enumerates supported document types or countries, and no published coverage list is cited. Missing for 10: a published list of supported countries, explicit coverage of passports/national IDs/driver licenses/residence permits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.
